description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer based in the United States. 

 We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to accelerate the adoption and business impact of artificial intelligence across the organization. In this role, you will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve productivity, streamline operations, and enhance customer experiences. You will transform complex business challenges into practical AI-powered solutions, moving quickly from discovery and experimentation to functional prototypes and production-ready applications. Leveraging technologies such as large language models (LLMs), APIs, automation platforms, and modern programming languages, you will help integrate AI into existing enterprise workflows. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, product, security, and business operations to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and effective. This is an opportunity to combine software engineering expertise, business insight, and innovation while helping shape the organization's AI transformation.

Accountabilities:
 

 Partner with business teams to understand existing workflows, identify operational challenges, and uncover opportunities to leverage AI for improved productivity, customer experience, and decision-making.

 Translate complex or ambiguous business needs into clearly defined AI use cases, technical requirements, and actionable implementation plans.

 Rapidly design, prototype, and develop AI-powered applications, integrations, workflows, and automations using LLMs, APIs, prompt engineering, and lightweight software development.

 Build and test solutions using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, ChatGPT, and workflow automation platforms.

 Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, internal data sources, APIs, and existing business processes.

 Design and implement LLM-powered solutions for summarization, knowledge retrieval, content generation, workflow automation, and decision support.

 Apply Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, and related techniques to connect AI applications with enterprise data and knowledge.

 Conduct rapid experiments and technical evaluations to validate feasibility, test assumptions, and demonstrate potential business value.

 Collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Product, IT, Security, Legal, and operational teams to transition successful prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions.

 Evaluate AI tools, models, and technical approaches based on performance, reliability, scalability, security, cost, and business requirements.

 Analyze and redesign existing business processes to maximize the value of AI rather than simply automating inefficient workflows.

 Identify opportunities to replicate and scale successful AI solutions across departments and business functions.

 Develop reusable components, prompt libraries, templates, implementation patterns, and technical documentation to accelerate future AI deployments.

 Test and monitor AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and reliability, incorporating user feedback and usage data to continuously improve solutions.

 Educate business users on AI capabilities, limitations, and responsible usage practices.

 Ensure all solutions comply with applicable security, privacy, governance, risk management, and responsible AI standards.

 Document implementation decisions, technical approaches, lessons learned, and best practices.

 Stay informed about emerging AI technologies and proactively identify innovative applications that address meaningful business challenges.


 Requirements:


 At least 2 years of hands-on experience developing or implementing AI-powered solutions, particularly involving generative AI and large language models.

 Proven experience building applications, prototypes, automations, or workflows using modern AI technologies.

 Strong proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python or JavaScript.

 Practical experience working with LLMs, generative AI platforms, and AI APIs.

 Knowledge of prompt engineering and structured techniques for improving the quality, consistency, and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

 Good understanding of APIs, data structures, software integrations, and modern application architectures.

 Ability to rapidly develop technical prototypes, test new approaches, and iterate based on stakeholder and user feedback.

 Demonstrated ability to understand complex business processes and translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

 Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and comfort navigating ambiguous challenges without predefined solutions.

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders and translate business needs for engineering teams.

 Strong customer-service orientation and ability to establish trusted relationships with stakeholders across different functions.

 Ability to balance rapid experimentation and innovation with security, privacy, reliability, and scalability considerations.

 Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, including engineering, product, business operations, and security.

 Strong written communication, technical documentation, and knowledge-sharing skills.

 Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.


 Additional Skills Considered a Plus:


 Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, or enterprise knowledge management systems.

 Familiarity with AI agents, agentic workflows, conversational AI, and intelligent assistants.

 Understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool and function calling, orchestration, planning, memory, and multi-step workflows.

 Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and SaaS platforms.

 Familiarity with workflow automation technologies such as Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, or similar tools.

 Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS or Microsoft Azure.

 Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, software development lifecycle practices, and modern development environments.

 Experience evaluating LLM outputs and implementing testing strategies for AI quality, reliability, and performance.

 Familiarity with AI security, governance, privacy, responsible AI, and model-risk management.

 Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.

 Experience in SaaS, communications, contact center, or enterprise technology environments.

 Previous involvement in transitioning AI prototypes or proofs of concept into production-ready solutions.

 Experience creating reusable technical documentation, implementation guides, and self-service resources.


 Benefits:


 Competitive annual salary ranging from $90,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

 Fully remote working arrangement, offering flexibility to work from anywhere within the United States.

 Full-time employment within a technology-driven and innovation-focused environment.

 Opportunity to work hands-on with cutting-edge AI technologies, including generative AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

 Exposure to a wide range of business challenges and opportunities to deliver measurable organizational impact.

 Close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, data science, product, security, and business operations.

 Opportunities to develop technical expertise and contribute to the organization's broader AI transformation.

 An inclusive and diverse workplace committed to equal employment opportunities.

 Reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities or other limitations, in accordance with applicable laws.
